result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but a few minor visual issues were found: a truncated restaurant card, potentially low-contrast placeholder text, and incomplete content at the screen bottom.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge and its name is truncated mid-word
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel snap points align so the full card is visible, or adjust truncation with an ellipsis

issues.description: Search bar placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is very light gray and may have low contrast against the light gray background
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to meet WCAG contrast guidelines

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (with -20% badge) is cut off mid-image at the screen edge, which is expected scroll behavior but leaves a partially visible heart button
issues.suggestion: This is acceptable for scrollable content, but ensure the full card is reachable by scrolling
